title: OWASP Benchmark (Java) v1.2
description: Test cases from OWASP Benchmark v1.2 with their published verdicts (expectedresults-1.2.csv): every case of all eleven categories once prepared with --pin (until then the pinned subset below). Scored per OWASP's own unit: a case is a file and a CWE, so only findings carrying the case's CWE count, and findings for other CWEs are ignored rather than counted against us. GPL-2.0, so NOT vendored: run the prepare script to fetch the pinned bytes into the gitignored .cache.
